metadata.title: Clicked like a confused chicken but somehow got 4 kills? Valorant just broke physics again
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like my brain was AFK.
Enemy probably uninstalling out of pure disbelief.
Pretending I meant to do that for 0.2 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a glorious mess but kills still stack up!

Tap if your aim’s chaos but kills keep coming!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
